source.expression:
def forward(self, x):
    out = self.conv_1(x)
    out = F.relu(out)
    out = self.pool_1(out)
    out = self.conv_2(out)
    out = F.relu(out)
    out = self.pool_2(out)
    logits = self.linear_1(out.view(-1, 7 * 7 * 16))
    probas = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)
    return (logits, probas)
